title: Old Rules in the Hall
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：can　|　正文 285 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 can 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1969 nobody in the hall ① could read the whole page, and every listener there remembered the fact for years. Three nights on the world had turned over: by then even the youngest listener ② can read the whole page in silence, and nobody troubled to watch. My uncle wrote the change into the programme at once, and read the line aloud once every night thereafter.

The rules, though, were older than either of those worlds. A visitor ③ cannot read the whole page before the December rains; the musician ④ could not read the whole page either, and said so plainly to anybody who asked. Nobody in the hall ever thought of arguing with him about it.

⑤ Could anybody read the whole page, my uncle wanted to know, without the musician standing beside them? My mother, who heard every version of the story, said we ⑥ could read the whole page once the programme was signed and not a day before. Even the oldest listener agreed with her in the end.

By 1975 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the programme: the work ⑦ can be paid before the December fair, and nothing was said otherwise. My uncle swore it ⑧ could have been paid long before anybody thought to ask. Could it truly have been paid so early? Nobody there could say.

⑨ In 1979 only one person in the whole hall could read the whole page without help, and my mother kept the name in the programme for thirty years. ⑩ Even today a stranger cannot read the whole page without permission, and that, my mother said in 1981, is what the old rule was really about. She repeated the sentence whenever the hall forgot itself.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. modal. 能够（过去形式 could read the whole page：1969 年那时候人人如此）
B. modal. 能够（现在形式 can read the whole page：如今连最小的听客也一言不发地做得到）
C. modal. 可以（许可）（现在形式的否定 cannot read the whole page：规矩不许，如今也仍然如此）
D. modal. 能够（过去形式的否定 could not read the whole page：那时的乐师也不能这么做）
E. modal. 能够（疑问句 could anybody read the whole page?：叔叔当年追问的话）
F. modal. 能够（间接引语 she said we could read the whole page：转述母亲的话）
G. modal. 能够（被动 can be paid：活儿被 paid 才算办妥）
H. modal. 能够（完成式 could have been paid：对早先情形的推断）

items.q: can read the whole page in silence
cannot read the whole page before
could not read the whole page
could anybody read the whole page,
we could read the whole page once
could read the whole page without help
cannot read the whole page without permission

answers.why: can 表能够，1969 年音乐厅里没有一个人把整页读完，叙述过去的事，故用过去形式 could。
can 表能够，多年之后连最年轻的听客都一言不发地把整页读完，说现在的情况，用 can。
can 表可以（许可），规矩上说客人不得把整页读完，否定形式是 cannot read the whole page。
can 表能够，乐师当年也不能这么做，过去形式的否定是 could not read the whole page。
can 表能够，叔叔追问的是“难道没有人能把整页读完吗”，疑问句 could anybody read the whole page?
can 表能够，母亲说的是“簿子签过之后我们才把整页读完”，间接引语里用 could。
can 表能够，节目单上那行字是说活儿必须在集前被人 paid，被动形式 can be paid。
can 表能够，叔叔断定活儿老早就被 paid，对过去的推断用 could have been paid。
can 表能够，1979 年只有一个人无人相助也能把整页读完，用过去形式 could。
can 表可以（许可），母亲 1981 年说，如今生人没有许可仍不得把整页读完，否定 cannot read the whole page。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1969 年，音乐厅里没有一个人把整页读完，人人都把这件事记了好多年。（could read the whole page）
多年以后，连最年轻的听客都一言不发地把整页读完。（can read the whole page）
按老规矩，客人在十二月雨季之前不得把整页读完。（cannot read the whole page）
那位乐师当年也不能把整页读完，谁问他就直说。（could not read the whole page）
母亲说，簿子签过之后我们才可以把整页读完，早一天也不行。（she said we could read the whole page）
叔叔一口咬定，那件活儿早在有人过问之前就被 paid 了。（could have been paid）

Three nights on, even the youngest listener can read the whole page in silence.

The musician could not read the whole page either, and said so plainly to anybody who asked.
